title: Fix Window Resize Cursor Hover
description: ui: When resizing windows, then not always our custom resize cursor is shown. e.g. on the left and right the default resize is wrongly shown.
summary: Extended cursor overrides in ui.css to cover all direction-specific cursors (w-resize, e-resize, n-resize, s-resize, row-resize, ne-resize, sw-resize, nw-resize, se-resize) mapping to custom SVGs.
